# What scripts/gen-manifest gives for manifest-tags.txt. Each line is
# KEY<TAB>TAGS: the tags of that kind, sorted, with one space between them.
#   port    the tags that name a port
#   anchor  the tags that have an anchor
#   index   the tags that name no port
